Definition: properly, to grate, i.e. (figuratively) to anger
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cause strife, stir up, contend, meddle, strive, be stirred up; 1a) (Piel) to stir up strife, excite strife; 1b)(Hithpael); 1b1) to excite oneself against, engage in strife; 1b2) to excite oneself (against foe), wage war
